text: {"lessons":["My account is about 3.9% below its Period 1 value, reinforcing that protecting retirement savings matters more to me than chasing gains.","I sold Stock B, D and E below my average costs; those losses remind me to judge each holding by its outlook and portfolio risk, not by trying to recover my purchase price.","The account has had both monthly declines and rebounds, and I have traded infrequently; I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and make deliberate choices suited to my living needs."]}
